name: kodescape-chat-widget
description: Embeddable website chat widget for Kodescape (Vite lib-mode, vanilla TypeScript, Shadow DOM)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit --pretty false && vite build && vite build --config vite.preview.config.ts && node scripts/verify-build-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:dev: tsc --noEmit --pretty false && vite build --mode development && vite build --mode development --config vite.preview.config.ts && node scripts/verify-build-artifacts.mjs
